contentWarning.obligation: the underworld ships with real content or not at all: exclusive fence-only postings, black-market stock depth, the information market, fence-side characters, #99 set-pieces; an unstocked fence is a spec violation

fences.disposition: reads the same #270 tallies as everyone; fences cheat (prices vs the desperate) and may sell word of a customer — a fence transaction is a #272 witness event with a professional witness
fences.gate: underworld #270 track at its gate band (draft: its Shady or deeper) OR bad-side #269 morale band at first approach; the shining are turned away and noted
fences.seats: #169 hideouts; organised face: #99 the Syndicate (whose supply chain for snag-class items runs through these seats — law seizures of fences strangle a region's stealing)

launderingLaw: THE RECORD NEVER LAUNDERS. No operation in any system removes or renames a #268 theft entry; a fenced Mochi's provenance still shows the theft to any reader (#227). What the fence sells is DISTANCE — from victim, witnesses, and warm trail — never innocence. Any future clean-record proposal meets this paragraph as a refusal already written.
note: Shape only — zero fences instanced, zero stock rows. Services, gates, price shape, and the laundering law are filled; identities and stock are world/item content.

services.buyStolenMochi: the darkest service: keeper seat to fence holding, keeping state stays stolen (#273); the product is a cold trail by distance; seller's deed -6 (#269)
